My best reading is that either (a) the length figure is a data-entry/transcription error (plausible alternates I cannot verify: ~7.5 km, or confusion with an unrelated ~75 km line elsewhere in the grid), or (b) one or both endpoints as recorded are wrong/incomplete (e.g. 'Ameriya' may denote a waypoint on a much longer trunk line rather than the true origin). I am reporting resolved:true because both named endpoints ARE real, identifiable, plausible places matching the sheet's Start/End cells and Arabic-adjacent naming (no Arabic name was given for this row), but the length and the ref supporting it should be treated as unreliable pending an Update-workflow source pass -- this should NOT be used to draw route geometry at 75 km without further research.
